gen-nosifer-instrument-sans: Dark and widely spaced, Nosifer pinches its letters shut. Instrument Sans is the open-ended counterpart: Nosifer gives you drama in every shape, while Instrument Sans keeps its lines plain and steady.
gen-nosifer-inter: Nosifer's pinched mouths, like a sealed envelope flap, are the first thing you notice in its tall, crayon-thick lowercase. And Inter works as the opposite, with breathing counters and a smooth, tube-like line that does the quiet explaining.
gen-nosifer-mulish: Mulish keeps every stroke smooth and its apertures open like a horseshoe magnet. Nosifer is best at shouting with pinched, crayon-heavy shapes, while Mulish does its best work when the sentences simply need to be understood.
gen-nosifer-poppins: Commanding and a bit sinister, Nosifer stretches its pinched, crayon-tall letters out with plenty of room between them. Poppins counters with loose, sturdy sans-serif curves.
gen-nosifer-roboto-slab: Roboto Slab reads precise and structured, with a dominant middle zone and open throats on a, c, e and s. Roboto Slab is built for steady lines, whereas Nosifer is best at dark, pinched-shut drama.
gen-nunito-sans-fs-literata: Nunito Sans is recognizable by its gaping c, friendly even at small sizes. Literata follows with a bookish, lightly shaded texture running through each word, adding sophistication to the page.
gen-pirata-one-bitter: Bitter reads dependable and grounded, with a very large lowercase eye and a visible gap through each s. And Pirata One is the gothic one, commanding the page with tall lowercase and tightly packed letters.
gen-pirata-one-instrument-sans: Pirata One packs its letters nose to tail, with a tall lowercase zone and compact ascender space. But Instrument Sans bends its lines like cable, with no swelling or thinning, so the gothic heading gets a modern, open partner.
gen-pirata-one-inter: Inter reads smooth and neutral, its big counters breathing through a tall lowercase. And Pirata One brings the gothic command, its letters sitting nose to tail with a tight ascender space.
